description: Update an existing monitor: rename, change frequency, pause/resume, or change its alert conditions, extraction and pre-check actions (requires a write-scope API key). Omitted fields stay unchanged; pass null to clear notifyWhen, notifyConditions, jsonPath, outputExtractorPattern, notifyWebhookUrl or actions.

active.description: Defaults to true; false keeps the step but skips it

selector.description: How to find the element, as a Playwright selector. CSS by default ("#accept-cookies", ".product .price"); a string starting with "/" is treated as XPath ("//button[contains(text(),'Show more')]"); Playwright engine prefixes also work, and "text=Show more" is usually the most robust choice for a button identified by its label rather than by a hashed class. Required for CLICK, TYPE, SELECT, MOUSEOVER and BLOCK.

type.description: CLICK an element, TYPE text into it, SELECT a dropdown option, MOUSEOVER to reveal a menu, SCROLL (optionally by pixels), WAIT a number of milliseconds, REFRESH the page, or BLOCK (remove) an element from the page before comparing

value.description: Text to type for TYPE, option to pick for SELECT, milliseconds for WAIT (max 60000), pixels for SCROLL

actions.description: Ordered list of interactions to perform before each check, e.g. [{"type":"CLICK","selector":"#accept-cookies"},{"type":"WAIT","value":1500},{"type":"CLICK","selector":".load-more"}]. Use this when the content to monitor is behind a cookie banner, a tab, a "show more" control, or a dropdown. Max 20 steps. Script and JS/CSS injection steps are dashboard-only and rejected here. Replaces the whole list; read the monitor first to keep existing steps. Pass null to remove them all.

active.description: true resumes checks, false pauses them

frequency.description: Minutes between checks, as a string: '5', '15', '30', '60' (hourly), '180', '360', '720', '1440' (daily), '10080' (weekly), '302400' (monthly). Omit for the plan default. A frequency faster than the plan allows is raised to the plan minimum.

jsonPath.description: For JSON API endpoints: JSONPath to the value to monitor, e.g. $.data.items[0].price. Starts with '$'. Pass null to clear.

keywords.description: TEXT monitors only: comma-separated keywords to look for, e.g. "sold out, unavailable" Pass null to clear.

keywordsAction.description: TEXT monitors only: alert when keywords are ADDED to the page (default) or REMOVED from it

conditionType.description: con = output contains value, eq = equals, not = does not equal, gt/gte/lt/lte = numeric comparison of the extracted output

notifyConditions.description: Deterministic alert conditions on the extracted output (no AI credits). All conditions must pass. Requires the output to change. Mutually exclusive with notifyWhen. Not available for HTML monitors. Pass null to clear.

notifyEmails.description: Extra email addresses to CC on alerts (workspace members are emailed by default) Pass null to clear.

notifyWebhookUrl.description: Webhook URL to POST alerts to (HMAC-signed with the account webhook secret) Pass null to clear.

notifyWhen.description: Natural-language alert condition evaluated by AI on every check, e.g. 'notify me when the price drops below $500' or 'alert when the Pro plan changes'. Mutually exclusive with notifyConditions. Pass null to clear.

outputExtractor.description: How to extract the monitored value from the page text: NUMBER pulls the first number (good for prices), REGEX applies outputExtractorPattern, NONE keeps the full text.

outputExtractorPattern.description: Regular expression for outputExtractor: REGEX — bare pattern or /pattern/flags; the first capture group (or full match) becomes the monitored output, e.g. 'In stock: (\d+)' Pass null to clear.

skillAlerts.description: Alert rules per skill, only when the user names a threshold or a rule, e.g. {"perf": {"lcp": 3}}: a number sets the rule's threshold and turns it on (seconds for timings, MB for page weight, days for expiry, 0-100 for scores), true/false turns a rule on or off, null resets it. Rule ids are in list_skills. A skill named here is added to the monitor. Merged into the monitor's current rules.

skills.description: Extra checks to run on the page at every check, each alerting on its own rules, on top of change monitoring: skill names from list_skills ('perf', 'seo', 'a11y', 'links', 'xss', 'tls', 'scripts', 'privacy', …) or plain words ('core web vitals', 'ssl', 'gdpr'). Add one only when the user asks for what it does. A skill the plan does not include is not added and comes back in skillsSkipped. Replaces the monitor's skills; pass null to remove them all.

name: update_monitor
title: Update monitor
